description: Change one of the person's job alerts by its id. Every field is optional and only the ones given change: name; the search (query, filters, salary_min, salary_max — each replaces that part, an empty filters object clears the facet filters, a salary bound of 0 clears it; website-only filters in `other` are kept); channels (the full set to deliver on — added ones must be connected, missing ones stop); paused (true stops every channel, false resumes them). The new search must still narrow the catalogue, and unknown values are dropped and named in ignored_params. e.g. remote senior Go roles in the EU paying at least 80k EUR is {"filters":{"work_mode":["remote"],"seniority":["senior"],"skills":["go"],"regions":["eu"],"salary_currency":["EUR"]},"salary_min":80000}. Digest timing is account-wide and not changed here. Effect: overwrites the alert's name, search, channels or paused state; a removed channel's record of matches is deleted with it.

channels.description: The complete set of channels to deliver on.

filters.description: Facet filters, the job search's own. Each value is a list of values from the facets tool.

paused.description: true pauses every channel, false resumes them.

query.description: Free-text query, with the job search's operators.

salary_max.description: Only postings whose stated salary ceiling is at most this.

salary_min.description: Only postings whose stated salary floor is at least this, in the posting's currency — pair it with filters.salary_currency.

name: update_subscription
title: Change a job alert
